question: Distinguish between profit maximisation and wealth maximisation as objectives of financial management. Which is preferred, and why?

points.label: Profit maximisation
points.description: Aims to maximise earnings, usually in the short run.

points.label: Limitations of profit maximisation
points.description: It ignores the time value of money and risk, and 'profit' is vague (different measures).

points.label: Wealth maximisation
points.description: Aims to maximise the net present value of the business, reflected in the market value of shares, taking account of timing and risk.

points.label: Why wealth maximisation is preferred
points.description: It is long-term, based on cash flows, considers risk and timing, and serves shareholders' interests.
